items.title: Minimum Wage
items.overview: Teens struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss and minimum wage in this series based on the hit social media shorts.

items.title: YAGA
items.overview: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

items.title: Phony
items.overview: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

items.title: Friends Sex and Games
items.overview: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

items.title: Crystal Lake
items.overview: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

items.title: Hollywood Arts
items.overview: Class is in session at Hollywood Arts! Self-proclaimed icon Trina Vega returns to steer gifted teens toward stardom, status and hilarious havoc.

items.title: VisionQuest
items.overview: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

items.title: The Trap
items.overview: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

items.title: My Love, the Black Sea
items.overview:
The series “Sevdam Karadeniz” tells the story of the enmity between two well-established families of the Black Sea region, which began with the unfinished love of Hafize Alazlı and Durali Yeniceli and, years later, drives their grandchildren Kuzey and Zeyşan into a forced marriage.

Amid secrets, forbidden loves, and vows of revenge, the two young people are forced to make a choice that will change the fate of their families.

items.title: Dustfall
items.overview: Seasoned detective Tig returns to her hometown of North Gap after years in the city, and uncovers a string of drink-spiking assaults, the case is turned on its head when a primary suspect is found murdered.

items.title: Treasure Island
items.overview: Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.

items.title: 100 Days of Deception
items.overview: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

items.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
items.overview: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

items.title: Take Charge of My Heart
items.overview: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

items.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
items.overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

items.title: Below
items.overview: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

items.title: Cupertino
items.overview: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

items.title: Eternally Yours
items.overview: Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.

items.title: Carrie
items.overview: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

items.title: NCIS: New York
items.overview: Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

items.title: GET JIRO
items.overview: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

items.title: The Reluctant Vampire
items.overview: A young vampire finds out he is not in fact a vampire at all, and has to live a double life.

items.title: Kill Jackie
items.overview: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

items.title: WAR
items.overview: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.

items.title: East of Eden
items.overview: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

items.title: Coven Academy
items.overview: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

items.title: Winter
items.overview: Dr Ethan Winter, an analytical detective, partners with driven DI Lauren Bell. His deductive genius aids her murder squad, but he's haunted by an unsolved murder of someone close to him.

items.title: LEGO ONE PIECE
items.overview: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

items.title: The Final Problem
items.overview: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

items.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
items.overview: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel 'Hondo' Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental SWAT unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities, and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city and saving the program that made him who he is.

items.title: A Different World
items.overview: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.

items.title: My Sad Dead
items.overview: A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.

items.title: Habeas Corpus
items.overview: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

items.title: Brothers
items.overview: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

items.title: Minerva Academy
items.overview: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

items.title: Youth
items.overview: A 50-year-old divorcee searches for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

items.title: Line of Fire
items.overview: A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.

items.title: American Hostage
items.overview: A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.

items.title: The Blame
items.overview: Detectives Tom Radley and Emma Crane fall in love while investigating the small-town murder of a figure skater, until one becomes a suspect.

items.title: The Split Up
items.overview: For Manchester's elite, family firm Kishan Law are the go-to divorce lawyers. But amid the messiness of love, marriage and deception, the personal and professional will collide.

items.title: The Scandal
items.overview: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

items.title: Plastic Beauty
items.overview: When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.

items.title: Not a Stranger
items.overview: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

items.title: Golden Axe
items.overview: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

items.title: Neagley
items.overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

items.title: The Doll
items.overview: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

items.title: City of Blood
items.overview: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

items.title: Route 187
items.overview: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

items.title: Cathedrals
items.overview: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

items.title: Tommy & Tuppence
items.overview: A detective duo for the ages, Tommy and Tuppence fall in love, fall out of it, and tumble back in, all while solving some thrilling and entertaining mysteries along the way.

items.title: Forever Home
items.overview: Carol Crottie grows suspicious when her husband Robert, suffering from dementia, refuses to leave their home. She begins to question what really happened to his first wife Joan, who vanished with his brother two decades earlier.

items.title: High Value Target
items.overview: In 2003, John Nixon, a CIA analyst became the first American to positively identify and interrogate Saddam Hussein. During their time together, Nixon began to understand the potential consequences of the invasion, the humanitarian horrors and geopolitical turbulences that would follow Saddam's deposing.

items.title: A Love Other Than Yours
items.overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

items.title: The Trial
items.overview: A teenager and her father struggle for justice after she is sexually assaulted by the scion of a successful businessman. Not only will the father and daughter have to navigate a failed judicial system, but they must also contend with a wealthy adversary bent on using all his power to protect his son.

items.title: Pls Love
items.overview: Cold and seemingly-perfect business heiress Peem reunites with Pan, a woman she once shared a fleeting seaside romance with–now working as a hostess at a luxury club in Bangkok. Determined to keep her close, Peem hires her as a personal assistant, forcing them to confront unresolved feelings, pride, and painful misunderstandings. As secrets and class differences threaten to pull them apart, both women must decide if they are brave enough to trust and love each other without judgement.

items.title: Alıkara
items.overview: A mysterious corpse draws Chief Inspector Deniz and Psychologist Işık into a grueling struggle. As the investigation deepens, long-hidden traumas from the past come to light, and the hunt for an anonymous killer begins…

items.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
items.overview: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

items.title: The Perfect Lie
items.overview: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

items.title: A Killer Story
items.overview: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

items.title: Last Seen
items.overview: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

items.title: Dang!
items.overview: After their sister Ruthie blows up her perfect life, Andrew and Eunice show her the fun in being flawed as she helps them adult.

items.title: Marble Hall Murders
items.overview: Returning to England, Susan Ryeland is reluctantly drawn into a new Atticus Pünd mystery, this time written by a new, young writer. 'Pünd’s Last Case" is a story set in 1955, in an exotic villa in Corfu – but the identity of a real killer is hidden in the text, and once again Susan is going to find herself in grave danger.

items.title: A Tale of Two Cities
items.overview: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

items.title: Lovesick
items.overview: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

items.listTitle: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
items.title: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
items.overview: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

items.title: You Maniac
items.overview: When a carefree playboy meets the one man who refuses to fall for his charm, his competitive ego turns into an obsession he can't resist.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

items.listTitle: All the Truth in My Lies
items.title: All the Truth in My Lies
items.overview: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

items.title: Dalliance
items.overview: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

items.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
items.overview: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

items.title: The Early Spring
items.overview: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

items.title: The Airport Chaplain
items.overview: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

items.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
items.overview: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

items.title: 9/11: Reunited
items.overview: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

items.title: Blood Sacrifice
items.overview: Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.

items.title: S&X
items.overview: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

items.title: Lion
items.overview: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

items.title: Lanterns
items.overview: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

items.title: Moria
items.overview: Moria Casán transforms her life story into a symbolic spectacle of fame, controversy and ceaseless reinvention.

items.title: My Brilliant Career
items.overview: Restless, razor-sharp and refusing to conform, 17-year-old Sybylla Melvyn is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.

items.title: Hit Point
items.overview: Two 30-something detectives, Leo and Bella, investigate a case leading them into London's criminal underworld. As they seek answers, personal and professional boundaries fade amid twists and betrayals.

items.listTitle: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
items.title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
items.overview: Tracing Charles Manson's rise as a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and his trial, using unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage.

items.title: Anna Pigeon
items.overview: Anna Pigeon flees city life for the solitude of America's stunning national parks following a devastating loss; while Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds.

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.overview: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

items.title: Possession
items.overview: Claudia, a bi-racial lawyer, journeys to Jamaica's haunted Connaught plantation to fight an inheritance claim. Uncovering dark historical secrets intertwined with modern injustices intensifies her nightmare.

items.title: Monsters of God
items.overview: Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love — reptiles — into the dark underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this billion-dollar global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails.

items.title: Sterling Point
items.overview: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

items.title: The Shards
items.overview: 17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

items.title: My Bias, My Boss
items.overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

items.title: Fightland
items.overview: A disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime syndicate he thinks betrayed him.

items.title: A Bona Fide Killer
items.overview: A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.

items.listTitle: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
items.title: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
items.overview: A successful entrepreneur with a seemingly perfect life sees everything fall apart after discovering her husband covering up a murder allegedly committed by their daughter. As the family scrambles to hide the truth, an anonymous blackmailer claims to have recorded everything, pulling them into a dangerous web of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

items.title: Benidorm Is Murder
items.overview: Former detective Dennis Crown has swapped the chaos of the UK for a quieter life running a bar in Benidorm. But when tourists start turning up dead, he's reluctantly drawn back into detective work-egged on by his barmaid Rosa, a crime drama superfan. With Dennis's real-world experience and Rosa's encyclopaedic TV knowledge, each episode sees the duo tackling a new murder in paradise, whilst trying to remain on the right side of the local Spanish cops.

items.title: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
items.overview: Through bodycam footage, texts and interviews with loved ones, this documentary investigates the horrifying murder of four University of Idaho students.

items.title: Furious
items.overview: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

items.title: President Curtis
items.overview: Follow the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

items.title: The Rapture
items.overview: As temperatures rise, a convicted murderer foretells apocalyptic disaster - is she a manipulative psychopath or does she know the truth? High-stakes thriller crackling with danger.

items.title: Summer of 1985
items.overview: In the summer of 1985, a young boy is found mysteriously drowned in the waters off Särsö. During a forbidden excursion to the legendary island of Svärtan, Johannes and his friends make a discovery that changes them forever.

items.listTitle: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
items.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
items.overview: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

items.listTitle: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
items.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
items.overview: A historical exploration about the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the preserved Roman city it left behind.

items.title: Elite Force
items.overview: After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

items.title: My Daughter's Father
items.overview: Follows Julieta who, during her graduation party suffers a life-threatening health crisis that forces her mother, Maca, to face secrets from the past.

items.title: Overdo
items.overview: In Republican Shanghai, Murong Qingyi, a warlord’s son swapped at birth, endures years of torment. His life changes when Ren Susu saves him, but tragedy strikes her family because of it. Years later, love sparks between them, but Ren Susu fakes her death to save another, leaving Qingyi heartbroken. Three years on, she returns as his future sister-in-law. Love, hate, betrayal, and old wounds resurface. As war looms, the two must defy fate together, but can love survive a nation’s fall?

items.title: Treasure & Dirt
items.overview: When a headless torso is found deep inside an opal mine, Ivan Lucic and Nell Buchanan are seconded to the desolate outback mining town of Nullah where law and order is optional.

items.title: Spooky in Love
items.overview: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.

items.title: The East Palace
items.overview: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

items.title: The Map of Longing
items.overview: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

items.title: Ann Droid
items.overview: It’s Sue’s worst nightmare - an overly attentive, socially inept, second-hand robot carer. But maybe this droid has its uses...

items.title: The Hairdresser Mysteries
items.overview: High-end hairdresser Lily Petal opts out of the competitive city scene to buy a small village shop at the top of a cobbled street.

items.title: Until Death Do Us Part
items.overview: When family lawyer Malin and her husband Tobias have the neighbours over for a drink, the police come knocking. The babysitter supposed to be looking after Malin and Tobias's children has been murdered, and Tobias is the primary suspect.

items.title: Ride or Die
items.overview: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

items.title: Night of a Century
items.overview: Fifteen of july 2016. That night, heroes proved that they exist. In that very night, Turkish nation stood up against traitors. Enemies of the state were brutally beaten by the Turkish nation. This is a story of betrayal, a heinous coup and a nation fighting for her freedom.

items.title: Lucky
items.overview: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

items.listTitle: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
items.title: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
items.overview: A three-part docuseries, revealing the true story of Jordan Belfort and his boiler room brokers at Stratton Oakmont, which is even darker and more debauched than previously known.

items.title: Dream to You
items.overview: Two high school classmates bond over a shared love of filmmaking, turning a deep friendship into first love before an unexpected separation tears them apart. Years later, they reunite with their lives completely transformed—she’s lost her passion, while he’s become a celebrated director. Determined to reignite her dreams, he must first confront the hurt he left behind.

items.title: Murder 101
items.overview: Part teen drama, part masterclass, and part edge-of-your-seat crime investigation, follow a high school sociology class in rural Tennessee who help revive a decades-old case into a present-day hunt for a killer.

items.title: The Westies
items.overview: As the Javits Center construction project ignites a battle for profit in early 1980s Hell's Kitchen, a generational rift threatens the uneasy peace between violent Irish gang the Westies and the Mafia, and draws FBI heat.

items.title: The Dark
items.overview: A serial killer stalks the Scottish wilderness. When a young man’s body is discovered, DI Monica Kennedy must catch the murderer before a small community is torn apart.

items.title: The Apartment Job
items.overview: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

items.title: Until the T-Shirt Dries
items.overview: A sudden summer accident shatters the peaceful lives of two couples, dragging a happily married editor into a web of grief, human selfishness, and her husband's hidden secrets.

items.title: The Man Will Burn
items.overview: Explores the definitive story of the Burning Man festival, filmed over three years with the co-operation of the Burning Man Project, the non-profit behind it, and featuring archive from the last 30 years.

items.title: The Five Star Weekend
items.overview: After her husband's unexpected death and a very public breakdown, famed cook Hollis hosts her best friends for an elaborate weekend on Nantucket.

items.title: Little House on the Prairie
items.overview: The close-knit Ingalls family builds a new life on the Western frontier, where the joys of nature and the struggle for survival are deeply intertwined.

items.title: Blossoms of Power
items.overview: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

items.title: I'm Not Afraid
items.overview: 10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.

items.title: The Husband
items.overview: Taeju and Seyun are on the verge of divorce. But when a drunken comment from Taeju gets Seyun kidnapped, everything changes. Even worse, he's now the prime suspect. Forced to go on the run, Taeju must rescue his wife on his own. To save her, he pushes himself to the absolute limit.

items.title: Human Vapor
items.overview: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

items.title: Elle
items.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

items.title: Worst Neighbor Ever
items.overview: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

items.title: Knot
items.overview: A young man’s life changes forever when a powerful Alpha marks him, binding their fates together in an inescapable bond.

items.title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
items.overview: Young hero Finn and his magical dog best friend Jake embark on adventures across the fantastical land of Ooo — partying with cloud people and punching evil in the butt along the way.

items.title: Ms. X
items.overview: A suburban mom and her high school friend plot to frighten her unfaithful husband straight, but their scheme spirals into murder, trapping her between law enforcement, drug lords, and ruthless PTA moms.

items.title: The Doomies
items.overview: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

items.title: Notes from the Last Row
items.overview: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

items.listTitle: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
items.title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
items.overview: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

items.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
items.overview: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

items.title: Deep In
items.overview: Filming a daring romance movie, an award-winning actor and an ambitious newcomer lose track of where acting ends and their real desire begins.

items.title: The Killings at Parrish Station
items.overview: It’s 1987, and Detective Georgia Cooke is called in to investigate the massacre of four scientists who have been brutally murdered in inexplicable ways, with a lone survivor the obvious suspect. But as Georgia digs deeper, unravelling a complex case entangled in mania, ritual, and the occult, her obsessive quest for the truth spirals into a nightmare that will put her family, career, and sanity on the line.  37 years later, a chilling new spree of murders will pull Georgia back into this nightmare as she confronts the terrifying possibility that the horrors at Parrish Station were never fully buried.

items.title: The American Experiment
items.overview: Life. Liberty. The pursuit of happiness. This sweeping historical documentary series traces how the ideals of America's founders gave rise to a nation.

items.title: See You at Work Tomorrow!
items.overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.title: The Edge of Horizon
items.overview: Years after being torn apart by rank and tradition, a prince and his first love reunite as buried feelings bloom once more.

items.title: Oasis
items.overview: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

items.title: In Love Forever
items.overview:
After a bitter divorce caused by family pressure and emotional manipulation, successful lawyer Runchlaphat and outspoken Gen-Z heiress Peeracha want nothing to do with each other. But when a high-stakes business opportunity requires them to appear as a happily married couple, the former lovers are forced back under the same roof.

As they struggle to maintain the illusion, unresolved feelings and painful memories begin to resurface. Meanwhile, Runchlaphat’s controlling mother, Gingkamol, remains determined to keep Peeracha out of the family at all costs. Surrounded by deception, pride, and lingering desire, the ex-wives find themselves trapped between the love they once shared and the wounds they never healed.

items.title: I Will Find You
items.overview: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

items.title: Possible Love
items.overview: Defne, a woman in her thirties, is strong and composed, having built her career through hard work. One day, she realizes just how exhausted and isolated she has become; perhaps the time has come for love. However, two men who enter her life turn everything upside down. Caught between Kadir’s unsettling demeanor and Tolga’s games that shift the balance, Defne finds that nothing will ever be the same again.

items.title: Never-Ending Summer
items.overview: To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

items.title: Different Lives
items.overview: For Emir and his friends—Hasan, Sadık, and Mert—who grew up in Ziyankâr, a working-class neighborhood on the outskirts of Istanbul, life feels like a game they’ve lost before it even began. Trapped between poverty, violence, and despair, these four young men see soccer as their only chance to change their fate. They try to break free from this darkness through their friendship and their dreams.

items.title: Proud
items.overview: When his carefree life is upended by an unexpected family tragedy, Filip is forced to grow up or risk losing all that he has left.

items.title: Viral Hit
items.overview: A bullied high schooler becomes an overnight sensation after a viral video. But when his newfound fame turns sour, he must learn to fight for himself.

items.title: The Evil Lawyer
items.overview: When a young attorney is accused of murdering a police officer's son, he teams up with the "Evil Lawyer" to exploit loopholes and prove his innocence.

items.title: Every Year After
items.overview: Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

items.title: Dragon Striker
items.overview: In a world where sports and magic combine, farm boy Key discovers his ultrapowerful natural talent and learns he could be the legendary Dragon Striker.

items.title: Alice and Steve
items.overview: Alice is devastated when her best friend Steve starts dating her 26-year-old daughter Izzy. She's going to lose her best friend and her daughter in one fell swoop. Alice tries everything she can to end the relationship. Unfortunately for her, Steve's more than ready for the attack, and what begins as a perfect friendship, devolves into an all-out feud.

items.title: The Vampire Lestat
items.overview: The Vampire Lestat goes on tour while being haunted by "muses" from his past. As the band's popularity grows, so does Lestat's influence over vampires & humans alike, leaving others to contend with Lestat's power in the face of the Great Conversion.

items.title: Among Us
items.overview: Eccentric, monochromatic crewmates of a ship transporting junk across the galaxy must root out an Impostor in their midst before they fall victim to its villainous designs.

items.title: Teach You a Lesson
items.overview: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

items.title: Cape Fear
items.overview: When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

items.title: The Witness
items.overview: With their 2-year-old as the sole witness to her murder, Rachel Nickell's partner fights to protect him amid a flawed investigation.

items.title: Two Years Later
items.overview: Daily bus flirtations between Emily and Ryan end with COVID. Two years later, they reunite and embark on eight dates to test marriage compatibility, facing personal challenges and differing views while finding true connection.

items.title: Michael Jackson: The Verdict
items.overview: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.

items.title: Not Suitable for Work
items.overview: Follow five work-obsessed twenty-somethings striving for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness in Manhattan's most glamorous neighborhood, Murray Hill.

items.title: Ashes to Crown
items.overview: The general's daughter, Chu Zhao, refuses to accept her fate as nothing more than a pawn to be sacrificed in Xiao Xun's rise to power. Taking matters into her own hands, she fights her way out with the help of Xie Yanlai, protecting the emperor's grandson as he makes his way to the emperor's presence. Through a tense standoff in the imperial court, she helps the young prince secure the throne, cutting off Xiao Xun's path to power. But with a new emperor comes new crises. The realm is torn by internal strife and foreign threats. Working alongside Xie Yanlai, Chu Zhao navigates the treacherous currents of the court, leads troops into battle, and ultimately rewrites her own destiny, sparing the people of the State of Chu from the ravages of war.

items.title: The Fortune
items.overview: Amanda Blakefield's life is a happy one, with her husband Jimmy and their son Luke. But when Amanda is left an enormous inheritance by a man she has neither met nor heard of before, her life starts to fall apart. Amanda becomes embroiled in the world of the Worralls, where Martin Worrall is head of a family bound in past secrets. As Amanda is drawn further and further into past events and relationships, all of their lives are turned upside down.

items.title: Doctor on the Edge
items.overview: In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

items.title: The Trio
items.overview: Middle-aged Hugo encounters his childhood loves' daughter, sending him back to when his younger self begins college. His memories offer a glimpse into a deeply entwined and emotionally complex story of yearning, as a love triangle becomes increasingly complicated. Tracing the emotional journeys of lead characters Hugo, Thora, and August.

items.listTitle: Bring Me the Beauties: A Model Cult
items.title: Bring Me the Beauties: A Model Cult
items.overview: Learn how Hoyt Richards was drawn into the spiritual group Eternal Values by its enigmatic leader Frederick von Mierers.

items.title: Tip Toe
items.overview: An ordinary Manchester suburb becomes a minefield of lies and violence when Leo gives neighbour Clive his spare key.

items.title: Torn Apart
items.overview: Aras, a fearless seventeen-year-old boy, comes to Bodrum to search for his younger sibling, the only remaining member of his family whom he lost at the age of five. His new life in Bodrum will turn into a challenging struggle when his path crosses with the Akkaya family, the most powerful family in the city.

items.title: Ticket to Heaven
items.overview: A grieving student pursuing priesthood faces a crisis of faith when he falls for a troubled new classmate in a world ruled by strict dogma.

items.title: Reborn Rookie
items.overview: After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.

items.title: Payback
items.overview: A grieving debt collector enters the entertainment world for revenge, only to fall into a dangerous attraction with a powerful executive.

items.title: A Dog and a Plane
items.overview: After a chaotic luggage mix-up, a broke paramedic and an ambitious flight attendant grow closer while exposing a cheating boyfriend’s secrets.

items.title: Brazil '70: The Third Star
items.overview: In 1970, the Brazilian national team took the field with big dreams and an even bigger challenge: to become the first three-time world champions.

items.title: Star City
items.overview: Step into a thrilling chapter inspired by For All Mankind. Same alt-history universe. Different perspective: the Soviet Union's. Go behind the Iron Curtain with the cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers who risked it all in the race for the Moon.

items.title: Make That Movie
items.overview: Make That Movie follows a hotshot director, played by stand-up comedian and actor Sam Campbell, scouring the country for everyday people who have an idea for a feature film. Sam and his team then race against the clock as they attempt to transform the idea into a film in just three days.

items.title: The Empire
items.overview: The series was inspired by the adult film industry of the 1990s and its well-known stars. It focuses not on the behind-the-scenes drama, but on people’s lives and the decisions they make. The new series from the creators of *The King* tells a story inspired by real events and wild fantasies.

items.title: My 2 Cents
items.overview: When his friend Wild Boar lands himself in hot water with organized crime, Zero and the gang unite to save him while barely coping with their own lives.

items.title: Spider-Noir
items.overview: Ben Reilly, an aging and down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life as the city's one and only superhero.

items.listTitle: World War II with Tom Hanks
items.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
items.overview: Explores WWII from Germany's invasion of Poland through the atomic age, examining pivotal battles, wartime leaders like Churchill and Roosevelt, and the human cost of total war.

items.title: Camatarii
items.overview: One of the most feared clans in Romania tells its inside story for the first time. This is not just the history of a clan. It is the story of a transition, of a Romania that paid dearly for the price of freedom.

items.listTitle: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle
items.title: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle
items.overview: The producers set out to help amnesiac Benjaman Kyle but uncover mob ties, twisted lies, and a sinister plan. He claims memory loss, but as the story unfolds, he turns on them. They soon learn he may be a hitman and a possible murderer.

items.title: Two Weeks in August
items.overview: A Greek holiday with friends to relax and reconnect. But when Zoe acts on her desires, heaven quickly turns into hell. Witty, painfully relatable drama starring Jessica Raine.

items.title: Ravalear: Not for Sale
items.overview: In Barcelona’s Raval neighbourhood, the family-run restaurant “Can Mosques” faces eviction after an investment fund buys the building. The family’s fight to survive escalates, pushing them to cross any and all boundaries.

items.title: Mating Season
items.overview: A cast of bears, raccoons, deer, foxes and a host of other horny, lovable forest critters navigate love, sexual relationships and the universal need to hook up and find a partner.

items.title: The Boroughs
items.overview: In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a crew of unlikely heroes must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time.

items.listTitle: Se tiene que morir mucha gente
items.title: Se tiene que morir mucha gente
Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
items.overview: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

items.title: Falling
items.overview: A nun and priest, each dedicated to their religious calling, unexpectedly fall in love and must confront what this means for their vows and faith.

items.listTitle: The Nightmare Upstairs: What Happened to Ty and Bryn?
items.title: The Nightmare Upstairs: What Happened to Ty and Bryn?
items.overview: When allegations of abuse irrevocably fracture a Utah family, a bitter custody battle ensues. After the court orders the children into a controversial reunification program, Ty and Bryn take matters into their own hands by barricading themselves in a bedroom for 54 days, livestreaming their protest, and turning an intimate family crisis into a national viral reckoning.

items.title: Summer '36
items.overview: Nice, 1936. As workers enjoy their first paid holidays, four very different women become entangled in the murder of a prosecutor at the Riviera hotel.

items.title: Kees Flodder
items.overview: Kees Flodder unexpectedly appears on the doorstep of her daughter, Kees junior.

items.title: You're Killing Me
items.overview: In a quaint New England town, bestselling novelist Allie forms an unlikely alliance with aspiring writer and podcaster Andi to find the killer of a close friend.

items.title: The Air
items.overview: When a violent coup erupts back home, Princess Catherine Blew De Laina becomes an assassination target while visiting Thailand. Her survival falls entirely on Lieutenant 'Lom' Vayo Watinwanich, a sharp female marine police officer assigned as her underground protector. Forced off the grid, the two women must navigate relentless tactical hits and political betrayal. As duty and survival blur, their isolation sparks an intense, undeniable magnetic attraction—a forbidden love defying rigid military protocol and royal expectations. Amidst constant gunfire, Blew finds safety in Lom's embrace, while Lom discovers a kindred spirit beneath the royal exterior. In a world where everyone has a price, their fierce devotion becomes both their ultimate liability and their only way out. Together, they must dismantle the conspiracy before the assassins close in.

items.title: The WONDERfools
items.overview: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

items.title: Dutton Ranch
items.overview: Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.

items.listTitle: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.title: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.overview: Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

items.title: Soul Mate
items.overview: In a moment of despair, Ryu Narutaki finds himself saved by Korean boxer Johan Hwang. As their wounded souls draw closer, their fates cruelly intertwine.

items.title: Nemesis
items.overview: A relentless LAPD cop becomes obsessed with taking down the master thief behind a string of daring heists — and only one can come out on top.

items.title: Between Father and Son
items.overview: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

items.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
items.overview: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.
